title: Tenma Saki — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Class is over!
It's finally time for lunch!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, Haruka, do you wanna go have lunch at the rooftop since the weather is pretty good?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we usually eat at the courtyard so I'm fine with that for a change.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't mind either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Then let's go now!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have arrived! It's my first time here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wah! Sorry!
I didn't think anyone would be here... Wait a minute...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, aren't you Shiho's classmate, um...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori? You're alone today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hi, Haruka!
Yeah. The friend I usually ate lunch with had something to do today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's too bad!
Do you wanna have lunch with us then?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Can I really? Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, I've finally achieved my dream of having lunch on the rooftop together with friends.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Having lunch on the rooftop was your dream?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It really feels like I'm living my high school life to the fullest, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You may be right!
This does happen very often in manga and anime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You see, you see?
And I also made a new friend!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right! I forgot to introduce myself!
I'm Saki Tenma. Nice to meet you! And this is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello. My name is Ichika Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And I'm Minori Hanasato!
It's so nice to meet you, too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You already know Kiritani, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Of course I do! The truth is...
Haruka's the reason I wanted to become an idol in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...
Does that mean you've gone for auditions before?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Countless times, though I've never passed any so far...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I won't give up, so I practice dancing here every day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Every day?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome! You're just like the main character in a manga or anime! You're really making the most out of your youth!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's the kind of life I wanted too.
To throw myself into something, like club activities and such...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's why you joined the soft tennis club, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, Ichi and I were invited to form a band together, so we're both doing our best with that too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're in a band?! That's so cool!
Which instrument do you play?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi's on the guitar and vocals.
I'm the keyboardist!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm gonna go shop for my own keyboard with Ichi real soon♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow... You're really serious about this!
And that's super cool!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's like they're old friends already.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Hanasato's a really nice girl, isn't she?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She is. That's probably why they hit it off right away.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Minori, you have my support for your idol dream!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks! Let's both do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's nice to chat, but you should really eat something too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Gasp! I was having so much fun I forgot about that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come on, Saki, you should eat too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for reminding me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Food always tastes better when you eat together with others!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Look at this, Ichi!
This person has some really interesting videos about makeup.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh? Rabbit eyes?
I didn't know that was a makeup style.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Just look at those cute eyes!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, they're cute. You can probably pull off this look.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? I'm pretty sure you can pull off this look too, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, I'm...not sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You absolutely can!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, if only I'd brought my makeup to school...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Only for the teachers to find and confiscate it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, there's that risk, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know! Why don't you drop by my house after school today? It's been a while, hasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your house? Now that you mention it, I haven't visited in a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Everyone used to visit pretty often when we were still first years in junior high.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But after I was admitted into a hospital far away, that just wasn't possible anymore...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah... I mean, that's why I thought it might be fun to hang out at my house again after such a long time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't have soft tennis practice today, and I'm not scheduled for any work after school too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What about you, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't have anything on today, either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I hope you don't mind if I drop by for a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course not! Thanks, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's try out lots of different makeup looks♪
Oh, and lots of different hairstyles, too, while we're at it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure. Let's try out everything you want.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! Which means I'm going to have to gather all the fashion magazines I can find in my house!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki... You're not going to try out every single makeup and hairstyle you find in those magazines...are you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... How'd you figure that out?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Fine, fine... I'll go along with that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
By the way, will Tsukasa be at home today?
I haven't met him in a while and should probably go say hi if he is.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ah, I think he'll be at his part-time job today.
He recently started working as a cast member at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't know that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can tell he's really enjoying himself every day!
Although, I haven't been able to watch any of his performances because our schedules keep clashing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why don't we go take a look together next time, then?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! I bet he'd be so surprised♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But today is makeup and hairstyling day!
I wish school could be over like now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, you know my hair's quite stubborn, so don't expect fantastic hairstyling results from it, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But your hair's so black and straight.
Smooth and silky hair makes me so envious!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think your soft and springy hair is a lot cuter, though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? It's so frizzy and hard to tame, but now I'm glad I worked so hard to curl it this morning♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! I'm going to come up with a fantastic new hairstyle that's perfect for your hair, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. But please go easy on me, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I can't wait for school to be over!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uh...
I'm kind of hungry.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too.
Want to go grab a bite?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are you in the mood for?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't know, lots of things... What's that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is that a new restaurant?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Where?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That one! See the signboard?
Huh, it says it's a specialty rice porridge restaurant?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um... Rice porridge, huh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, it was trendy for a while.
They marketed it as a healthy food that's easy on the stomach.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess it's still popular if a restaurant with nothing but rice porridge on the menu can stay in business.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's one trend I could never get behind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right, you don't like rice porridge.
You were complaining about it every time I went to see you in the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I liked the other hospital meals, though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's just rice porridge that I hate, hate, hate!
Every time I had it, it had zero flavor, and it was like eating slime!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm never having it again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What about when you're sick?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I ask my parents to make me udon noodles instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's a good alternative.
Udon's easy to digest too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right?
So there's no reason to force dreadful rice porridge on sick people!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which reminds me... Check this out!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's the website of the hospital you were in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, but see this?
We've improved our hospital menu.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. So it changed since you were there?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uh-huh.
Just look at the pictures, the food actually looks tasty.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even the rice porridge! You can still make out the grains of rice, and they even put slices of sweet potato in it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not boiled down into mush.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They finally learned to cook it right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why couldn't they have made it this way when I was in the hospital?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If they did, maybe you wouldn't have this aversion now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think so too! It looks so good, I might even be persuaded to try a spoonful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm done with hospital meals.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now I want to stuff my face with foods I couldn't eat back then!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, let's feed you some real food.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But don't overeat just because you can now.
I don't want to have to roll you out of the restaurant.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yikes, reaching perfect roundness is not in my plans!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Buuut, you burn more calories when you exercise, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So as long as I do lots of sports at school, I can stuff myself with lots of tasty foods and still be super fit!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess so, but make sure you know your limits with both of those things...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You've been buying lots of snacks and candy lately. Might want to cut down on that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, cut me some slack!
I had to make do without them for so long!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You said you wanted to be super fit, though?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh come on, you're being mean to me today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, just teasing you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, where do you want to go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm, how about that cafe!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Good job, everyone!
I raise a toast to you all!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We had a good one!
Hehe, it feels like a special occasion.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was just a regular rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So what?
Aaah, this hit the spot!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You drank the whole glass of juice in one go...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They have free refills! I've got to get my money's worth!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
By the way, I got these fries to share!
Can you reach them from where you're sitting, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're even more chirpy than usual today, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's because I'm so happy that another of my dreams has come true!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What dream is that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Having a lively meal with you at a diner!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's one of the things from my must-do list for when I went to high school, that I wrote while I was in the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's very touching.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm really happy to be here too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't think we'd get the chance to spend time together like this again. Thank you for proving me wrong.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Aw, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What she said. And we've even got a band now. Who'd have thought?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. So much has happened lately.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki came back, we met Miku and Luka, and started a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, it was chaotic at first but it's all going well now and every day brings more fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Unlike in middle school, I'm not going to miss a single day at school, or even a single class.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm in the soft tennis club, and in a band, and I get to hang out with you at a diner!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can do stuff like visit Phoenix Wonderland or go to the mall!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Doing anything together with you guys is great!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, in that case...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll have to help you go through that list of must-do things, one by one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I was so lonely and sad during my hospital stay...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm glad it's over!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Thanks to the sports club, I've gotten fitter. No more getting sick and missing out on time with my friends and high school life!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's going to be fine now... Definitely...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... What's the matter, Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why... Oh... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha, don't worry, these are tears of joy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, are you sure? You're not hurting, are you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm fine!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's not like it's our last meetup or anything.
No reason to get overly emotional.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, we can come here any number of times!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Guys, can we have another toast?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are we toasting?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's...health?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh... That's like, what you do for really old people, no?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, that's true, but let's do it anyway.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine by me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, so...
Here's to Saki's health!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I've had a rough patch in my life but now I'm back with my friends once again.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was nice, Ichi! Thanks, guys!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Saki. You're on your way home too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Oh, and listen to this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I just had bubble tea with Ichi and the girls!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! That's one of the items on your List of 100 Things to Do Once I'm Back in School, isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It is!
So I got another one of my wishes fulfilled!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm happy for you, Saki. To be honest, that was one of the items I was worried you may not be able to fulfill.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? Why? It's just buying a drink...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How can you say that?
Fads and fashions come and go.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You couldn't buy one even if you wanted to if all the bubble tea shops closed down one day, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's what you meant...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There are a few more items on your list that are dependent on these ever-changing fads.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So make hay while the sun shines! Without overworking yourself, of course.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Go after the items on your list that are currently trending!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's true, and I don't have to be afraid of missing out on the latest trends anymore! I'm all fired up now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're going at a pretty good pace already.
I remember you recently fulfilled the item about joining a school club, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You make this all seem so effortless...but that's exactly what you would expect from my very own younger sister!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for suggesting the 100 Things to Do list to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's this all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The list helped me focus on the positive things I could do when I started going to school again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, I may have made a full recovery, but I'm in the recuperating stage, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It would have been so easy for me to not feel like doing anything at all because of worries about my health.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the list makes every day so fun for me! I get to think about what new thing to try today, or what I should do first to fulfill another item on the list!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So it's because of you that I've been enjoying my school life so much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, think nothing of it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was only doing what any big brother would've done! Just keep relying on me for anything at all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you'll get easily carried away and goof up in the end...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nope?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay? Well, it's great that school seems to be going well for you. You get to hang out with your childhood friends Ichika, Honami, and Shiho too, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah... Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What's wrong? Why the glum look?
Meeting them again was the one thing you looked forward to the most, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah... I'm in the same class as Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Shiho and Hona are being very distant for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mhm. Maybe they're just awkward because it's been a while?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But the way Ichika is acting makes me feel like there has to be something else going on...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa... Do you think the four of us could ever go back to being best friends again, like in the past?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm... Not a clue!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Shouldn't you be cheering me up with a confident, Of course you can! there?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Listen, sister dearest.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What's more important is the present!
And the future ahead!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The future...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right! Set your eyes, not upon the unchangeable past, but the ever-changeable future of unlimited possibilities!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just work on making them your friends all over again! It'll be like tasting two delicious flavors with one bite!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay... Setting that strange analogy aside...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A future of unlimited possibilities, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph. I have once again give birth to yet another memorable quote. Bow before my wisdom! Ha ha ha ha!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Eep! Qu-Quiet, Tsukasa!
You're causing a disturbance!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But... It's so amazing. When Tsukasa's the one saying it, it really feels like things will work out somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Don't go back to the past, but look to the future...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Okay. I have to face Ichi, Hona, and Shiho properly, the way they are now!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Will you listen to me again if anything happens?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm your big brother! Of course I will!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪ Humhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki seems really happy about something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. She's been like this since morning.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, because today's the day, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been looking forward to this since the day we decided we'd all go together♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's fine, but make sure you can focus during practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am! Okay, let's head to the studio right away!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huuumhuhum♪ Humhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on, everyone, hurry up!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's gotten even more hyper than before practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The way she gets completely carried away from her excitement is exactly like Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They're siblings, after all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhuhuum♪ Ah... The queue is already so long!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow. I thought the craze already ended a while ago.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, how can you say that?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This was the one thing I was looking forward to enjoying the most when I got discharged from the hospital!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine, fine. Let's join the queue and stop blocking the way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, did you see how mean Shiho was to me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's okay! She said she'll buy extra toppings for you to make up for that. Didn't you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho

rows.Line: Yeah! It's gonna be so much fun!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are!
Hona, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good morning, Saki. Thank you for inviting me to your Doll Festival party the other day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you! Being able to celebrate with everyone there was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And about Tsukasa...
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
By the way, Hona...
Are you free today after school?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I think so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Then can you help me out with something? Please!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm home...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good! Tsukasa hasn't come home yet. Hona, come inside!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, okay... If you say so...
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, there's juice and snacks too, so have whatever you like!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Saki. Um... So what exactly am I going to be helping you with?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: About that... Can you take a look at this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, aren't these the dolls you showed us during the party?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You said Tsukasa brought them to you when you were in the hospital the one time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! And they mean the world to me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But their kimonos, like the sleeves and stuff, are starting to fall apart... See?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. I was wondering about that too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa went through so much to deliver these to me then and it's one of my most precious memories...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it apparently kept bothering him too all this time, so I thought some love and care might be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know, so that Tsukasa stops feeling bad about how they look now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I want to ask how you might fix these, Hona. You have amazing sewing skills so...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you think it's possible...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It may be a little difficult, but I think it's possible. Let's try together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you, master!
Please show me the way!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. How about we start with the emperor?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hnng... Ow!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah... *Sigh*...
I've poked myself so many times already...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: These dolls wear such tiny kimonos but they're so elaborately put together. It's no wonder we're having such a tough time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Saki... If the arm inseam is too much, I can do it for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks. But...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is about me and Tsukasa, so I should be the one to do it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. I understand...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... What about this, Hona? Should I line up the patterns on the fabric before sewing them together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and after that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Done... Finally!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Great work, Saki! I can't believe you really did everything by yourself!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You explained everything in a way that was really easy to understand! Thank you so much, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Saki, I'm home. Hm?
Is everyone else here too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*...! T-Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have to hide the dolls...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome home, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Just Honami today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stay as long as you like, or well, within reason...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I think we're in the clear...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, why did you hide them? You spent all that time working so hard...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, but I thought that it might be a nice way to surprise Tsukasa next year when we set them up♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm also hoping that we'll be able to have another Doll Festival party with everyone next year too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see...
We'll all be looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, uh... Hona...? Can you make this our little secret until next year?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course!
One day, during lunch
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, we're back♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Tenma, Hoshino.
Did you get what you were after?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We did.
Thank you for waiting too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: An epic battle to see who can get the best bread! Something you can only experience in high school♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But doing this every day would be a little much. I wish we could go buy them before lunch too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I see you got another yakisoba bun, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
I can't help but buy them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I got a hold of a melon bread today♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You've been craving one since yesterday too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, passing by the melon bread shop after practicing so much really didn't help! I was starving!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I should pat myself on the back for not immediately giving in to temptation there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Practice? Oh, you mean band practice?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You've done a ton of shows, Haruka, so I was wondering... What's it like to perform in one? What's it like to do a show?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, that doesn't sound like a fair question.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's okay.
What's it like...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're always short, only a few hours, but you get to see all these fans gather and have fun together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, and...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're an important chance to directly reach out to them with your music. It's a time when you and your fans get to come together as one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: As one...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And the sea of glow sticks is so beautiful since it looks like everyone's bursting with light and energy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As each song starts, the venue shakes as the crowd cheers and you can hear everyone from even on the third deck. It's an incredible feeling...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
That sounds awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we have something a little less grandiose in mind for now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ASRUN shows always seemed to have fairly high attendance figures, didn't they...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That may be true, but it also depended on the venue as well. When our tours included the big domes, we'd get anywhere between 30,000 and 50,000 guests...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
50,000?! Hold on...
How many does the gym seat?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know...? At the very least, everyone in the school would have to fit, which means...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. That probably won't help you much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, don't say that! The part about shows being super fun and exciting sounded amazing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But even then, 50,000 is something else. I'm not sure I'd be able to sing in front of so many people...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I get nervous even when I talk in front of everyone during student council meetings.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get jittery whenever I have to announce anything in class too. I can't imagine what it would be like to do that in front of the entire school...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I was the same when I just debuted. I always felt so nervous.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka? Feeling nervous?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Sometimes my mind would go completely blank and I still don't remember what happened during my first few shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, really?! How did you get used to being on stage like that?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It wasn't so much about getting used to things as it was about realizing something. When my fans started calling my name and cheering for me, I figured it out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I knew then that they're on my side and that there's no need for me to be afraid.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, okay! That would make performing in front of them a lot more fun, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. They're the difference. They make it happen.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I understand where you're coming from...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been training in secret for a little while now, and I got a taste of that too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! You still haven't told us anything about what you've been doing! Please, Ichi, tell us...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I'll keep it a secret for a little while longer. I'll tell you everything soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I didn't know fans could make such a huge difference. To be fair, we haven't even done a single show yet...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Shiho's already subbed in as a backup bassist a lot where she works too...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And Hona's played in front of people for the junior high brass band...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ichi's been doing some secret training, whatever that is...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So does that mean I'm the only one that's never played in front of other people...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, you're not mad, are you...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? No, why would I get mad over something like that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was just thinking that I can't wait for us to put on a show together as Leo/need♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (As long as we're together, even if it's our first time, I feel like we can do anything!)
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew... Finally, we're done...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice work.
That was much harder than usual.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah. We're aiming to go pro after all!
We might need to start doing even more!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. That explains why everyone's been so fired up...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, Ichika, thanks for waiting. I'm done cleaning up over here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! Then let's get going!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Miku, MEIKO, thank you for today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: See you later.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? They seemed to be in a hurry. Is there something they have to do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. They're going out somewhere.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They are? Oh, thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank goodness? Why?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was a little worried about them is all. They all seemed a little too wound up, you know?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Practicing is important, but rest and relaxation are just as important. Especially if they actually plan on becoming professionals, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that may be true, but I wouldn't worry too much about the girls when it comes to that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They're all trying their best and deserve a little reward for their efforts so far.)
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aha! Found it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Everyone! Over here!
The Flufftacular ☆ Petting Zoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So much fluffiness♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Just calm down a little, will you...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Look, they have pictures of all the animals we get to see too. Hamsters, rabbits, little birdies... And some dogs and cats too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
C'mon, let's go!
Excuse me! Four high schoolers, please!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Here you are. You'll be able to go in when this group is finished, so if you'll please wait here...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: And the back of each ticket contains information about the animals you'll be able to meet and we ask that you decide on a few to see before going in.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, we won't be able to see all of them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The animals probably need rest too so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nice, it even says taking photos is okay as long as it's not flash photography♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Just try to keep it down when you're around the animals, alright?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I will...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wh-What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm just happy that you told us about this. I had no idea something like this was going on.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, I just happened to hear about it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happened to...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. She just happened to...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wh-Why are you all looking at me like that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can't keep pets at home, so you've found an app that lets you do that, right...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You even mentioned something about wanting to take care of some real ones too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I did...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah!
I kinda want one of the rabbits you've been raising, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that would be nice.
I'd like that too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Wait, I remember telling you about it being an animal app, but I don't remember ever telling you that I was keeping rabbits...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku told me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And I heard from Honami.
You have some cats too, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona told me! Minori too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She said the look on your face while you were playing with them in the courtyard was priceless!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Minori also told me that your sister's been keeping some rabbits and birds too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You both really like small animals, huh♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I can't deny that.
Oh, the line's moving...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's already our turn next.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! We have to get as much fluff in as possible!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
All that fluff♪
I think it has actual healing powers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You might be right. We took so many pictures too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also! Ichi, show Hona and Shiho that thing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right! That!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was this lop rabbit...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, this one! Doesn't it make the same face as when Hona's savoring a delicious apple pie?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh... Wow... Heh...
Y-You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?! D-Do I really make that kind of face?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like looking in a mirror.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And this one with the deadpan expression looks just like Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey, hold on.
If you want a look-alike, see this one...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Is this...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's called an Angora rabbit, and the way its fur's all over the place looks just like Saki with really bad bed head.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, no... Hehe... It's true...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No way?! My hair never gets this bad! Also, you can't even see its face...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My hair might be all over the place sometimes, but you can always at least be able to see my face! Well, most of the time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's been a while since we hung out like this.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And we won't have much time to go out and have fun like this if we really are gonna try to go pro...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But you know what? I'm glad we are!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. We're all on the same page. We're aiming for the same goal now.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you keep spacing out, we're gonna leave you behind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, Hona... Shiho's being mean to me again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. There, there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We'll be together a lot more from now on. We'll be chasing after the same dream and I know we can make it come true!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, Hona, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's keep giving it everything we got!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I told Shiho that I want to see what I'm capable of, but songwriting's turning out to be so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I am trying to take a look at this from a couple different angles...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But none of the melodies or riffs that I've come up with so far felt right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I want to help our band by contributing to our music somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Saki. There you are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, it's you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I came to ask if you had already tried any of the fruit jellies that were in the freezer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... Mom told me about them earlier. I think I'll pass for now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is something bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I know! The one you were looking for wasn't there! It's no wonder you seem so down, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? I don't really feel all that sad or anything...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why not just try a different flavor? You never know, it could be good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Take myself for example. I tried a grapefruit-flavored one just now even though I'm not exactly a fan of them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, I'm in high school now! I'm not a little kid that gets all pouty over something like jellies anymore...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? If you say so.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then tell me, why do you seem so down? Remember, you can talk to your magnificent big brother about anything!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Says you, oh magnificent one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you know, I think I'll take you up on your offer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lately, the girls and I have been talking about coming up with an original song for our band...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: An original song! That's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, and I was convinced that it'd be super fun and stuff at first...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I even decided that I'd contribute by helping write songs for the band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it hasn't been going well at all...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And even though I know how to play the piano, it feels like I haven't been able to fit it into our music at all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I keep asking myself what it would be like if I could just play a little better...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not sure I can answer that question for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, being able to play the piano doesn't automatically mean you'll know how to write songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! Didn't you and Toya used to play the piano together when we were kids?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, you mean when we played at the same time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I remember you wanting to see who could play it the most freely or something, and really banging away at the keys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your description isn't doing it any justice. There was definitely a certain kind of melody or rhythm we were playing to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? I totally felt like Toya was doing all the work while you goofed off.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: L-Look who's talking! Didn't you jump in right after that and cause an even bigger racket?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I was just copying what you were doing! I wasn't fooling around like you were, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But in the end, Toya just kept at it to try and make whatever musical mess we were making work.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Looking back, I feel a little bad for him, but then again, we all seemed to be having a good time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Maybe that's it. Maybe I just have to let myself go a little more...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Saki...
Is it tough being in a band?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
No, it's not what you think!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I am having so much fun playing and performing with everyone! I love every minute of it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I want to do more to help our band grow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why... I know things won't go well in the beginning, but I want to do what I can.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So it is tough in that sense... But I feel like it's just something I have to deal with for now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. Good for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're doing what you love and properly committing yourself to it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And ultimately, all good things must come to an end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... No, the others and I have some experience with that too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You do...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We fail and put everyone's efforts to waste... And even when we propose to create something good, they don't feel the same...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Or even when we haven't changed, our surroundings change and let ourselves get lonely...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We become so obsessed with our own dreams and full of pride that we end up hurting the people close to us...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you had a tough time too, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are you apologizing? This is exactly the same as that tough hurdle you just mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And don't worry, it's all in the past now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We overcame that and are putting on outrageous shows even today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Is it really okay to call your own shows outrageous, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Outrageous, unique, one of a kind! They're all compliments in my book!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha. My brother the optimist.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I get what you're trying to say. It's not all fun and games...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have to be willing to put everything on the line to become a pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you say for sure that you'd be able to do that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Shiho knew that from the start. She knew that we'd face something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
