rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We can finally eat these.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's so yummy and rich...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it's sweet but gentle, and very smooth.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Uh oh, Ichika...
Your ice cream's starting to melt down the side.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
My hands are going to get all sticky.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait...
Hehe. It's just like what we talked about back then.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, that was about how the cone probably would've melted in our hands since it was also made of ice cream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, let's finish these before they melt away.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Nom... Hm?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no! The cream's becoming unbalanced because it's melting!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, Saki, it's gonna fall!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-You can still save it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And... Got it...
Safe!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: H-Hehe... Haha!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Finally... Homeroom's over...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki!
Did homeroom for Class C also just end?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! But Ichi's gotta stay behind for classroom duties. She might be awhile.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay...
We'll have to wait for Shiho too. Homeroom for Class A still hasn't finished yet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, is Ichika's finger okay now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! She showed me earlier and it's completely healed!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank goodness... I was sort of startled when I heard about what happened in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was kinda shocked when I heard that you broke one of your drumsticks, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... I didn't break it. I actually just cracked it a little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! I was totally under the impression that you'd gotten so buff that you'd snapped it in half!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, you may be right. My arms do feel a little stronger now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I can drum for a long time now without feeling fatigued.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! That's so cool! It means real changes are happening!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm not sure if this is related, but my upper arm also seems a little slimmer now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm actually happy that it's gone from being a bit flabby to being toned.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Hona!
Mind if I feel your arm?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Be my guest.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...
It really does feel toned...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Now try flexing for me!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay.
Ready?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hnng!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!!
This is so cool! Hona, your arm's rock solid!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I'm gonna try doing that too♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hnng!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Guh! It still feels soft...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I've been doing my best every day... I guess this means I need to practice more...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm not sure there's much you can do about that since playing the synthesizer doesn't involve using many big muscles...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Plus, outward physical changes aren't the only thing that shows how hard you've been working.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I mean, Saki, you always stay and practice until really late, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! How do you know about that, Hona?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This one time, when I went to talk to MEIKO about staying behind to practice, I heard the sound of someone playing the synthesizer coming from afar.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That really encouraged me and made me want to try harder.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you! I love you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wah! Oh, Saki...
You just can't help it during moments like these, can you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's because you're too nice, Hona.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm really glad.
Your cheeks are as soft as ever♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna rub-a-dub-dub them even more!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Hehe!
Wait, Saki, that tickles...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Well-toned muscles are nice, but I think I prefer it if the rest of you stays soft and cuddly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Hmm... Really?
I'd rather not be too soft...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you doing to her, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm getting my fill of how muscly and cuddly Hona is.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'm not sure either, but there's quite a few other people watching.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?!
No! Hona's all mine! They can't have her!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um...
I don't think that's why they were watching...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're all here, shall we get to training?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wouldn't mind running like that again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we don't have time to individually practice playing our instruments. Moving forward, we're gonna need to play as much as we can as a band and push each other to do better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Try to keep up with me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Thank you for believing in us, Shiho!
We promise to do everything we can to keep up with you!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: N-Nice work...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's pretty late now.
We should probably clean everything up as quickly as possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay... I should also help clean up...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Trying to keep up with Shiho is just so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We got to finally practice as a band today, but we never really got in sync...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(No, this was just our first day...!
We still have two weeks! We have to figure out a way!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For us to reach your level, Shiho, we'll probably have to spend less time eating and sleeping in order to practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Even so...
I want to make that happen before our show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You make it sound so simple...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But that's easier said than done.
Until now, we've been practicing with everything we have without cutting any corners.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But to ask you to do even more...
What if one of you collapses from exhaustion before our show...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I don't care.
I'd rather have that happen than regret not practicing as hard as I could've.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Th-That's right...
I went as far as saying that I don't care if I collapse...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Shiho, I bundled up all of the cables.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks, Len.
I can handle the rest.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, I'll lend you a hand once I'm done cleaning up here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks, but that's okay.
I'm actually just about to finish.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Um, then... Wanna talk about what could've gone better during practice today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What's with all the tip-toeing?
Can't you just say what you want to ask?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... Um...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember what I said during our last practice? About how I didn't care if I collapsed...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I know that it'd be really, really bad if I actually did collapse from exhaustion!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I cut back on sleeping and eating so that I could practice instead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I even asked to have my shifts reduced at work and to take days off from club activities in order to focus on our band!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I kinda wasn't joking when I said that I didn't care if I collapsed from exhaustion...!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry. I know.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Based on all of your expressions that time, I could tell that you guys were being serious, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not only that, when you were writing your new song, you managed to complete it after taking a really hard look at yourself, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's no doubting your commitment at this point, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho...!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I'm hoping that you'll get through this... Let's put on the best show Leo/need's ever done.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Yeah...!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll do whatever it takes!
Even if the Earth gets destroyed!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? I sorta doubt that you'll be able to if the Earth gets destroyed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'll still do it♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?
Why are you hugging me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Just watch, Shiho.
I'll show you that I can get through this!)
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, my keyboard's nice and clean now...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I gave this song a really close listen, so I should be all set for our big music video debut!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm getting really nervous!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As excited as I am about us shooting a video, I don't know how I'm gonna do!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: N-No, I'll be fine! I practiced a ton, and it's not like we're livestreaming it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, I shouldn't be worrying so much just before our shoot...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our big debut's gonna be so awesome that we're only gonna need to do one take!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna psych myself up by watching some really cool ones!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, the others might know about some good ones! I'll ask them in the group chat♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, they replied!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I've been using this band's music videos as reference. It's incredible how they seem to be able to find and use the perfect effects for their songs.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<This band too.
I'm not sure I can do the same thing as them, but it was interesting to see the way they created all these elaborate visual representations.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! I can't wait to see either!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Thanks, Hona! I'll check out both of these! I'll share some music videos that I really like too♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi and Shiho just replied!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <I'd like to see your video recommendations as well, Honami.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <I actually really like the band that made the second song you posted, Honami. This one's also really good, so I hope you all get a chance to watch it.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nice! Shiho also recommended one!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Thanks for sharing, Shiho♪
I can't wait to watch it!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <That's great, but don't get so excited that you're not able to fall asleep, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Heh heh heh.
Joke's on you! I was too nervous to sleep anyway!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Wait, how's that a good thing?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <But that's okay. If I do have trouble falling asleep, I can just try out some of those tricks you all taught me that other time.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Hey, what do you guys do when you have trouble falling asleep?>
I wonder if anyone's gonna reply...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Good morning, Saki. Are you having trouble falling asleep because you slept during the day?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Some healing music might help you relax. I'll post a few songs I like, so I hope you get a chance to listen to them.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <If you need a way to relax, then I recommend stretching. I'll post some good videos for you to watch.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
<What about reading a textbook?
I'm guessing you'll be out like a light after five lines of your history textbook.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Oh, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Thank you all so much! I'll try all of your suggestions♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I ended up going through my math textbook because I actually like reading the one for history.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Your math textbook? Wouldn't the questions be the only thing you can actually read?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Also, Saki, didn't you end up not able to sleep that time because you realized how you'd forgotten to do a homework assignment?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Ichi, that was supposed to be a secret!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Huh?! I'm sorry!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Relax.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, that's so kind of...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, what's with this snickering stamp?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, there's two?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I'm glad you remembered to do your homework.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<I knew you'd say that!
You're like the goddess of kindness!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Anyway, it's getting pretty late. I'm gonna go to bed.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm? Whoa, she's right!
I need to go to bed soon too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Okay, I think I will too. See you all tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <See you tomorrow!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <I got in a good laugh before bed, so I'm looking forward to some fun dreams. Night, everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho... You really didn't have to say that last part...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I do feel a lot better now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I'll watch the music videos they all shared and then go to bed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait for it to be tomorrow!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hurry, you guys!
We're almost there!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You keep saying that, but it feels like we've been going in circles...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... I suppose it's only natural to get a little lost while finding a shop that just opened.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we should be on the right track this time. The sign we just found seemed like the correct one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, here it is!
The new pancake shop!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And they smell really good...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?
It seemed like the perfect place for us to celebrate a job well done on our music video♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we all seemed interested in checking it out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I've definitely worked up an appetite, so let's head in.
Inside the Pancake Shop

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, you get to choose what kind of batter they use. Which one should we get...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Didn't you look up some recommended choices beforehand, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm glad you asked, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I recommend the fluffy soufflé!
That with whipped cream and fruits on top is apparently the most popular combination!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Soufflé pancakes do sound good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Seems like a safe choice seeing as whipped cream and fruits are also pretty standard...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, based on the pictures in the menu, they come with a ton of whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's supposed to be really light and not super sweet, so you should be able to gobble it up just fine!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Some people were saying how it sort of just disappeared before their eyes as they ate it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You researched all that information for us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course. I came fully prepared today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. And yet, we ended up getting lost along the way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Urgh... Cut me some slack. I didn't realize that it was down such a narrow alleyway!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona... Ichi's teasing me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's okay, Saki.
We know you did your best.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And no teasing Saki, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, Shiho, you're looking through the menu so seriously! You almost never do that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your recommendation did sound pretty good, Saki, but also fairly standard. But I'm getting lost in all these choices...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, even though they have all these different things, you're going all plain and simple?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho... Don't you know that a shop's plain and simple choice is what separates it from its competitors?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Depending on the convenience store, the fried chicken tastes different and hot dogs aren't fried the same way, right? That's what I'm talking about.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You say that, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I understand.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How crisp the crust and apples are for a pie are going to differ quite a bit based on which bakery you go to.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that makes a little more sense.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mostly get what Saki meant about convenience store food.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi...!
I knew you'd understand!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After telling on her for teasing you just now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Thank you for your patience. Here are your four plain pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, they're so big...
But they look so delicious.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, so... Let's...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, wait!
We should take a picture first!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would we fit if we all squeezed in?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Just be careful not to get whipped cream on your clothes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ready?! Say, “Cheese♪”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now for our much-awaited pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Here's to a job well done on an amazing shoot and music video♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, let's...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Dig in!
After school
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We're finally done readjusting the schedule.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Also, Saki, Ichika, you two seem...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Our song and lyrics are really coming along!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Getting to focus on songwriting and practicing makes for great progress. Thanks for making this possible, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright then, let's start our practice after a quick breather.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
Saki, Ichika, how's that other thing coming?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What other thing?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Their assignment for art class.
I heard from Honami that you two still haven't finished.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is that true?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Haha... So...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were supposed to wrap them up during class today, but Saki and I ended up falling asleep...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We got chewed out pretty hard...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You fell asleep?
That's kinda surprising.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It must be a sign that all the work you were doing took its toll.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
But I was being so careful about not falling asleep.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. Unfortunately, we couldn't overcome the sleepiness that came over us during our first afternoon class...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That means you need a way to sleep without being discovered☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, that doesn't make it okay to fall asleep during class.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, they probably wouldn't have been scolded if they weren't found out...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel bad since the teachers always do their best during class...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi and I both learned our lesson...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I was really taken aback when the teacher said, “Quit fooling around and draw what's in front of you!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Quit fooling around...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
You rebutted and tried to defend what you were doing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You gotta hear this!
We did sketches of a sculpture during class today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I psyched myself up and tried my best to draw it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But around the time I finished drawing the outline for it, I started getting sleepier and sleepier...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I see. You sorta took a sigh of relief because you'd reached a checkpoint...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But I still hadn't drawn the shadows and stuff, so I tried to stay awake and keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I became so sleepy that I ended up drawing a gash across the face of my sketch...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... I can certainly picture that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It sounds like something you'd do, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But something like that can be seen as a simple mistake. How does that turn into “fooling around”?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
About that...
When I panicked and tried to erase the line, it started getting all black and blotchy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, it was like my sculpture grew a little mustache...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: H-Hehe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You must be joking! A little mustache...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't laugh!
The teacher got really mad at me for that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, the teacher couldn't help but believe that you fell asleep after doodling...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Talk about being unlucky...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
They understood in the end, but it still doesn't change the fact that I got scolded...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, neither Saki nor I finished our drawings, so we have to wrap them up tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does that mean you two are gonna be late for practice...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, we shouldn't be!
Our plan is to get to school early and finish them then!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We can't let our mistakes affect all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
But don't push yourselves too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, let's start practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Playing like you mean it should make you forget all about that scolding.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's do our best again today!
Early morning
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew...
Thank goodness we managed to finish our assignments!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And it was so nice of the teacher to get here early.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm so glad♪
Now we can keep practicing without worrying about anything else!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe we both fell asleep during class like that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You actually get to do stuff during art. As busy as we were preparing for our solo show, I'm surprised we couldn't stay awake...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. Let's be sure to never do that again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: On top of getting scolded by the teacher, we have to spend extra time making up for our mistakes. I'd prefer to avoid all that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
I think that was the first time I ever got scolded by a teacher!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's not true.
You definitely got scolded during elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Remember when we tried to fling our shoes across the schoolyard?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You flung yours into the teachers' office and they got really mad at you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...
R-Right. I kinda sorta vaguely recall...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Saki.
At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I might not mind this kind of thing every so often.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, same!
I really don't want to get scolded again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it really feels like we're enjoying school life, you know♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I understand what you're trying to say, but does getting scolded by a teacher count as us enjoying school life?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It so does! Because it's like one of the cornerstones of being a student!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, sure. That's bound to happen to anyone at school... But I'd sort of rather enjoy school in a more positive way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In a more positive way?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, such as...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How about volunteering for something together...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, volunteering!
We could collect donations or pick up litter somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Remember how we did that a few times during elementary school?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Going somewhere with your classmates while class is in session is something you can only experience when you're in school, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Stuff like that's always really fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, also...!
Getting the blackboard to be totally spotless! That's something you can only do at school!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I never thought about that, but I agree about it being very school-specific.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Exactly!
And I always love using the machine that shakes chalk off the erasers♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I hear some voices in the distance...
That must be everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Oh, that's it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, wanna say good morning to everyone as they enter our classroom?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A hearty greeting to start off the day!
That's also really school-like, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Those are the kinds of things I'd never think of doing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, Saki, let's say good morning to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki! Mom just poured us some after-dinner tea!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong? You look concerned.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, don't tell me.
Did you not have enough to eat during dinner? Or would you like some dessert?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? No, I'm not hungry or anything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just... What we talked about during dinner is kinda bothering me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, the thing about Mom and Dad going over to have dinner with Toya's parents at their house?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought that meant we'd get to go over too, but it's just adults only this time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be fair, they've known each other for a very long time, so it makes sense that they'd want to have a meal as friends.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But if it's adults only, where does that leave Toya? Wouldn't he sort of have to eat all by himself since it's gonna be a party for just our parents?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Toya might not mind...
But if it were me in his shoes, I'd be pretty against it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Hmmmm...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmmm... Ah, yes, that's it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If our parents are going to have a dinner party with just them, why don't we throw ourselves a dinner party here?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Isn't it?!
Go on! Shower me with more praise!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Way to go, Tsukasa! You're the best!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You two certainly seem to be enjoying yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Mom! We were just talking about throwing our own dinner party here!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
I see.
Would you like me to relay this to Toya's mother?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?! You will?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Of course.
But you need to check with Toya to see if he's free, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! It's already getting late, so we'll ask him about it later!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope your party turns out well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks, Mom!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa!
What should we have for our dinner party?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, we could have pizza, chicken, sushi, some other dishes... Oh, we could even have a spread of hors d'oeuvres!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! Those all sound so good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can't wait♪
Doesn't this remind you of when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we used to have dinner with Toya quite often whenever he came over to our house.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly. Every time we heard that Toya was coming over, we always asked Mom if we could help! I remember that being so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, Toya enjoyed it as well.
Not only that, but helping prepare our own meal made it feel just that much more special.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, guess what♪
I just thought of something really amazing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. What a coincidence, Saki. So did I.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's say it together on three.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's cook dinner for ourselves!
We should cook something!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You came up with the same idea as me. I should expect no less from my sister.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Same for you, brother.
You thought of the same thing as I did.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's go with that! We're going to put together an incredible feast!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That means we need to come up with a menu!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. Why don't we start by thinking about what we want to eat?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. What do you think Toya would like? It'd be great if we could come up with a menu that he'll really enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it would!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, let's start our... I forget, is this our third one? Our third meeting to decide the menu for our dinner party!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, our goal for today is to make our final selections!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! So, I'll begin by announcing the candidates for side dishes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: First, we need some kind of salad, so I think one with tomatoes would be nice!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Some red and juicy tomatoes should help add a bit of color to our menu!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's excellent!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our next candidate is the onion marinade Mom taught me how to make! It's the perfect appetizer since it has such a refreshing taste to it♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that should set the stage for our main dish rather nicely!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right? But I also wanna hear your suggestions, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, then... Why don't I announce the candidates for our main dish?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is so exciting...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What did he pick...?!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We had so much fun during our last meeting that we couldn't really decide.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How does something visually appealing like rice omelets sound?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we could decorate and write whatever we want on them using ketchup!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, along the same lines, we could also make Salisbury steaks♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How amazing would it be if we whipped up some really huge ones?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I like that. Simple but stunning. Not only that, Salisbury steaks are delicious!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup yup♪ Delicious is definitely important!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, also! How about beef stew?
The one Mom makes is so good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and we may be able to as well if we were to learn her recipe!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, we have to at least mention pot stickers... Each family makes them using different ingredients, and Mom even has her own special recipe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: True. Ours are usually brimming with meat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I remember hearing how Hona's family makes them with lots of chives and veggies.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that sounds very healthy.
The opposite of the ones at Rui's house.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do they do at Rui's house?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, they apparently only have meat in them because Rui absolutely detests vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahem... I shall now announce the candidates for our main dish!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: First! Beef stew!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yum!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Based on what Mom told me, it's a bit of an involved recipe but doable as long as we take it step by step.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! That's big if it means we can make it ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be fair, we haven't actually picked it yet. Anyway, second! Rice omelets!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's our chance to make them look really fancy for our guest...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. Mom also said that we should be able to handle making them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I saw the recipe and it's much less involved than the one for her beef stew.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... I guess it comes down to the details, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, but the more we pay attention to the details, the more delicious and satisfying our dishes will be.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As such, I vote for beef stew!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What say you, Saki?
Which would you rather have? Beef stew or rice omelets?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I've watched Mom make her beef stew before, but she really seemed to have her hands full.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (On top of having to chop all the veggies into the same size, you have to cook everything at the right temperature...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Still, as hard as it is to make, she's willing to go through all that in order to have us eat her yummy stew.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've made my decision, Tsukasa!
I also vote for beef stew!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want Toya to have our family's special dish!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Excellent!
Then, we'll have beef stew as the main dish!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Next, we need to choose our side dishes! I have a few other candidates besides the salad I mentioned earlier!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, lay it on me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm not that confident when it comes to cooking, but I think I'll be fine as long as I have Tsukasa there with me!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. I really hope Toya enjoys everything...!)
Live House

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We're just getting started!
Try to keep up, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(We're already through three songs!
We gotta maintain this momentum and keep raising the temperature!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Everybody, together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(This is so awesome...!
The crowd's singing along! They're totally into it!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Nice!
They really liked what I just did there!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Hehe...!
I'm grinning. I can't seem to contain my joy!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(And they're responding so well!
It's like we've become one with them!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This is nothing like our usual events!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This is what it means to put on our very own show...!!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Everyone! I'd like to thank you all once again for coming out to see Leo/need's first solo show!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... We've played a few songs back to back now, but I'd like to take this opportunity to say something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I'd like for my bandmates to say a few words since I'm usually the one who does all the talking.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is there anything you'd all like to say?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
I wanna introduce our members!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-Introduce us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We did that at the beginning. We're doing it again?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Band members usually introduce themselves by playing their instruments and stuff, right?! I think that's super cool!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I like it a lot because it makes shows feel more real in my opinion♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Saki, you always slightly change the little tune you play when we introduce ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, you noticed?! You're such a good listener!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That also applies to this show!
I changed it up a little just for today!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Play it again! I wanna hear what's different!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
I guess we should give them what they want.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, if Saki's going to do that, why don't we try mixing things up in another way?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
Let's have the crowd join in too! They can give us a big whoop each time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I like that.
How about it, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, Saki, it was your idea, so lead us off.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What, I get to go first?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You did come up with this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Whenever you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, here it goes♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ahem!
Please allow me to introduce the wonderful members of Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: First, on the drums...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Leo/need's bedrock foundation, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Next, on the bass!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The always cool and reliable...Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, our lead singer and guitarist!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A girl who's super nice, amazingly awesome and loves flowers to death! Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And on the keyboard!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me—

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The tireless heart and soul of our band! Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was hoping to get in a quick breather here, but the energy seems to be in a good place... Why don't we just jump right into our next song?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Everyone! This is the sprint to the finish! Let's keep this energy up all the way through to the end!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Wow! I'm not sure how, but we seem even more connected to the audience now...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This is so amazing...! My heart won't stop pounding!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But we're also through half our show already...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I need to put my heart and soul into every song... No, every note!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (To make sure everyone feels genuinely moved by our performance!)
CD Shop

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, here it is...!
“The Miku Collaboration Album!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's great, Ichi!
I'm glad they still had some limited-edition ones in stock!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too! We were so busy getting for our solo show that I completely forgot to reserve a copy. I was worried that I wouldn't be able to get one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You really have amazing luck when it comes to these things, Ichika. Remember how you got the last copy of that other CD?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What if it's because they're Miku CDs?
They might've been waiting for you to come pick them up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That's a nice thought.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll take this up front.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪ See you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, while we wait, wanna check out what they have in the shelves in the back with all the indie bands?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Indie bands? That sounds fun♪
Let's go! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
All the artists on these shelves...
They're all indie bands?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, this shop usually has a pretty good selection.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like... Oh, found it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! The artwork's so cool!
Do you like this band, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More that they're people I know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You know them?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I subbed in for them a couple times when they were down a bassist, but I heard they found one and made their debut a little while ago...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really?
Then, they're more experienced than us, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In terms of being pros, yes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Pros...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's okay. You weren't gone long.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm gonna buy this one if you guys don't mind waiting a bit...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You spaced out for a second there. Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, um... No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're really gonna go pro soon, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We still have our contract to discuss, but if things go well, yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My mind still hasn't quite caught up yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Mine neither...
But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In the not-so-distant future, we might start seeing our own CDs on this store's shelves...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This isn't a dream, right?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We really get to keep playing music together... As pros...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, hey...! A STANDOUT CD.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right. They're being featured as a one of the hottest indie bands out there right now. I guess they are just that famous.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If Shiho joins them, she could actually make it and debut as a pro...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what if she starts drifting away from us...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I felt so sad that time, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The four of us finally made it to this point...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I hope we get to keep playing music together and have our songs heard by lots of people!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki, you seem so happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I was just imagining what it might be like when they make a big display for Leo/need♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A display just for us? I think you're getting ahead of yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's important to visualize these things, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They said on TV that visualization leads to success!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't that just for professional athletes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What are you...? Oh yeah, it is.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Hona, Shiho, why are you guys in my classroom?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why do you think?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ready? Three, two, one!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup♪ I've already invited her too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you want me to go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I want to show Happy Everyday and you, the person behind her, my full appreciation!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you've sorta already done that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, that's just the tip of the iceberg!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You made me smile so much and were an absolutely gigantic source of encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Then, I happily accept your invitation!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You weren't able to contain your excitement for the rest of the day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like when the two of us went to invite Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Harukaaa!
We've got a present for you♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, is this a ticket to a show...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, you need to explain what it's actually for first...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you mind telling me more...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You two invited her yesterday, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shizuku talked about our show during their morning practice, which tells me that Momoi and Kiritani already knew...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Were they just being nice and playing along?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, nothing...
Anyway, who else was there?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I invited Asahina, but she said she probably won't be able to make it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Between school and other things, she always seems incredibly busy. When I messaged her about this, she said she couldn't quite work it into her schedule.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
That's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was really hoping that she'd be able to come since she's part of how I got to meet Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't worry! This won't be our last chance to show our appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because we can just make more chances by doing lots and lots of shows♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll go next.
I invited Emu and Ena the other day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, that's it for tickets and invitations!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wow...
Almost everyone we invited is gonna be there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm sure they'll be expecting to see a good performance. So, let's do our best not to disappoint them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We'll be fine!
I mean, we've been practicing like nonstop every single day!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: True. And we need to keep that momentum going after school today in order to make sure they understand just how much we appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Shiho & Honami
rows.Line:
For sure!
Yeah.
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Welcome home, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
You're back sooner than expected.
I thought you were all going to throw an after-party or something...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: We're gonna make our own snacks and stuff, so we're having it on a later date♪

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: More importantly, did you look outside?! It's absolutely incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Incredible...? Oh, the meteor shower!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Mom, Tsukasa, you gotta check it out! Come here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Okay, we're coming.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
This breeze feels so nice...
And there aren't that many clouds out tonight.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, what a beautiful night sky.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Look! Over there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, a shooting star!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom, did you see it?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, I saw it.
Oh, there's another one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Two in such quick succession!
I can't imagine what this is going to be like at its peak!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me neither! And now that our show's done, I can enjoy it to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: At the same time, Saki, I'm so sorry... I wish I could've gone to your show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, that's totally okay!
Work is work, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're gonna do lots and lots of shows as pros moving forward, and you guys will always be welcome to come see us perform!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know I've caused you a lot of stress, so I'll make up for all that by putting on a really amazing performance♪

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Then, when you do...
I promise to be there with your father!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My little sister... She loves her parents so much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, as your brother, I could not be more proud...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Tsukasa, why are you the one who's tearing up?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Your father was asking about your show, Saki. Please be sure to tell him how it went.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But he's probably still at work, huh?
I'll send him a message for now♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“Our show was a huge success♪
I got home just now. I'm watching the meteor shower with Mom and Tsukasa!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, why don't you also send him a picture?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, great idea!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, we'll have the stars in the back...
Mom, Tsukasa, come closer!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Are we all in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I'll send it to him now♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sounds like someone's worked up an appetite.
I'll get back to making dinner now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that's right. We're having curry tonight!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
C-Curry?!
Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Dad just replied!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, what did he say?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Congratulations on a successful show!
I also just saw a bit of the meteor shower with my coworkers!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, he added a picture!
Check it out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, he used the sky as the background too! Nice one, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
He is still at work, right...?
Also, what's with this silly pose?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This is Dad we're talking about...
It must mean something!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
He has his arm by his waist, but he appears to be holding something while trying to raise it in the air.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He's also holding something else with his other hand.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
This pose looks really familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, he's pretending to be Perseus...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just look at this illustration of his constellation! Aren't they identical?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only did he reply, he took this fun picture for us. As we should expect from Dad!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
And he had someone at work take it for him...
Hehe. What are we going to do with him?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! The person who took it must've been cracking up♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh... I think my stomach wants to be heard now...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, dear...
I should finish making dinner before it decides to do anything rash.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll help you, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, me too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aren't you tired from your show?
I should be more than enough...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I wanna help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I appreciate it. Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Of course!
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm all set to go.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm also ready.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, let's have another fun practice today and—

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, I think your phone's ringing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's my boss!
Sorry, I need to take this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hi, boss. Tenma here.
Yes... Yes, that's fine...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why do you think her manager's calling her...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This could be about them doing that shoot for TV. Saki's scheduled to work that day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot.
That shoot's fairly soon, no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not only that, Haruka and the others will be there too—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wh-What?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
O-Okay, I understand.
I'll also try asking around...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone, please answer this as honestly as you can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How would you like some extra money...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: ...which is why this person with a ton of experience won't be able to make it that day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we urgently need someone to fill in now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What about any of the other employees at the cafe?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, my boss did manage to find someone who can come in that day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But they won't be able to make up for years of experience. Which is why we still need one more...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By the way, what does this job involve...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm... You'd be waiting tables and putting on the finishing touches to sweets.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Like decorating them...?
In that case...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How about it, Hona...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As much as I want to help, I unfortunately have a prior engagement...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do you honestly think I can wait tables?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, how did you...?! And don't give me that look!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't want to get your hopes up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In any case, Ichika seems like the best person for this job.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... I probably wouldn't have too much trouble waiting tables, but I'm less sure about decorating sweets...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, wait!
Ichi, you know how to make hamburgers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That just basically involves stacking things together. Anyone can do it as long as you follow the instructions...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're talking about parfaits and stuff, right? I really don't know if I'll be able to decorate them properly. Even just putting on dollops of fresh whipped cream might be...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't worry! I was also really terrible at first! This one time, my dollops of whipped cream all turned into cream-shaped ghosts!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Please, Ichi...!
You're my only hope!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And you'll get paid!
You can buy whatever clothes or delicious food you like!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The money does sound nice...
But I still feel that I won't be all that helpful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
Just waiting tables alone would be huge!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please...! I seriously don't have anyone else that I can turn to!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Think of it as helping me and the cafe...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll help if you can't find anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so glad for you, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, I really don't think I'm cut out for decorating sweets...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, how about I take over the decorating?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I have a feeling you'd be very good at that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ichi, Shiho!
I love you both so much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't forget the part about looking for someone else first, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know!
Hehe...!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
It's time to start our Late Nite Wednesday Talk Show viewing party♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Round of applause!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. This is so exciting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know. Everyone at school was talking about it too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, most of the girls in my class said they saw it. They were all over Minori after it aired.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The same thing happened to Haruka.
I wish I could've joined in on the fun...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You could have if you didn't suggest that we have a viewing party...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's always better to watch these things together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, get ready!
It's gonna be a fun show♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Hey, everyone! Ready to catch another...?!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Big wave?!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: <Cowabunga!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Let's see what's hot right now!
It's trend surfing time!!!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I got to see them do this part in person!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, here! I'm out of frame, but just behind this shelf!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, we can't see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sit here for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Now then!
Today, we're visiting a cafe called “carino/carina” located on Main Street in Shibuya!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Lately, their new Mount Everest strawberry parfait has been going totally viral on social media.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Did you see?!
The camera caught me for a split second as it panned!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? I didn't see you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's rewind! Yeah, see...!
Right here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
The shelf and partitions are casting a shadow on you, but I guess that's you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, it is me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm so happy!
They got me right off the bat!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, we get it. Can we keep watching now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure♪
Play.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That segment was very good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was. Haruka said that they'd only be given about ten minutes, but it ended up being close to twenty.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They probably got a lot of good footage and didn't want any of it to go to waste, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Especially when Minori and the others started helping the cafe staff after that group of wrestlers came in.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, there was so much excitement going on that time just flew by.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm so happy for you, Saki.
I don't think your cafe could've asked for anything better.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also... I'm sorry that you didn't get to appear much...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For some reason, Otori ended up getting more airtime, and she didn't show up until much later.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. She appeared for a few seconds here and there after Minori and the others began helping out...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I was so excited about getting a chance to appear on TV...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, why do you want to be on TV so badly...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because it's TV, silly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, why wouldn't you be happy to be on TV? I'd probably tell everyone I know about it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I get how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I didn't realize you wanted to be on TV that much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
No, it's okay. It's not like anybody would've recognized me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, you poor thing.
There there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As unfortunate as it is that you didn't appear, everybody there must know how hard you were working to keep the cafe running smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, cheer up.
I'm sure your boss couldn't be happier with how you handled things.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Pat me more!
And shower me with more praise!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You did a wonderful job.
I'm very proud of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're so easy...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I think she's right.
You did everything you could for that cafe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're such an amazing girl, Saki.
Nobody works as hard as you do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Aren't I♪
*Sigh*
This is the best...
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh, preparations complete!
Now if Tsukasa will just come home...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: I'm home!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! Welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Tsukasa, do you remember what you promised to do today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
We're working through the list of things you want to do, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, which will it be today?
“Race into the sunset”...? No, perhaps “Put on a show with Tsukasa”?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Neither!
I mean, that second one isn't even on my list!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! I-Is that so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, but let's still do that sometime!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... Today, we'll be doing this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm... Wooden blocks? And books, notebooks, writing utensils, shogi pieces...
What on earth are we going to use these for?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Have a guess! We're gonna line these up all in a row, and then knock them down with a clickety clack!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aha! So, a domino chain, yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thaaat's right!
I watched a domino chain competition on TV back when I was in the hospital, and it made me want to try!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, now that you mention it, you did have that on your list. Still, to think you'd use items from around the house in place of dominoes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Such creativity and drive!
As expected of my sister!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright!
We'll set up our dominoes all over the house, and make a successful chain!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmmm... This notebook is hard to stand up since it's so thin... Ahh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry, Tsukasa!
I messed up and started the chain, so stop it over there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
Leave it to me! Here it shall meet its—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Gaaah!
I stepped on a block! My foot, my fooooot!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Are you okay, Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How can we get it to go down the stairs...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Shouldn't it work if we use objects that are taller than the steps?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Taller than the steps... Oh, like these fashion magazines!
No, they won't fall right, and they'll end up breaking the chain...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, what if we used this ball?!
We can place some books a little bit apart and make a path for it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's a good idea!
Okay, let's put it to the test!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's done!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew... Now we just hope that it makes it all the way to the finish line!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay... Here we go, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Three, two, one... Start!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here's the corner we were having trouble with... Yes! It got past!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And the stairs... Woohoo! It made it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, just a little more!
If it'll just continue until it rings the bell at the finish line...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We did it, Saki!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah... Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... So this is how satisfying it feels to make a successful domino chain...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! I feel like I just finished a show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I kinda feel like I just finished a set at a live house too! Oh...! I've gotta get a picture to remember this feeling by!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Use the selfie camera, get the finish line in the shot... Tsukasa, you get in too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Over here?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, perfect!
Okay, here goes! Ready...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, thanks Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, if I'm doing it for your sake, I could do this in my sleep!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, how many things do you have left on your list?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just over ten more, thanks to the help I've had from my friends and seniors at school!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! To think you've already accomplished that many of them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, the day you complete your list is likely not far away...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was able to make so many fun memories because of your suggestion to make this list!

rows.Line: Morning...

rows.Line: Oh, I was just telling Shiho about what happened during dinner last night at my house.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Dinner?

rows.Line: My mom was gone for the evening and I had a little time on my hands, so I decided to make dinner for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My little sister...who used to be so small... Now she's making fabulous feasts for us... I-I-I'm overcome with joy...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He suddenly started crying about that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, that's so sweet!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:

Your dad also started crying uncontrollably, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It must've been their way of expressing how happy they were!

rows.Line: I wish I could eat something you made too, Saki! Oh, what did you make for them?!

rows.Line:
Spaghetti with meat sauce!

rows.Line: While we're on the subject, what did you two have last night?

rows.Line:
Japanese dishes as always.
Braised fish, pickles, miso soup and such.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that totally suits your house too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, at my house!

rows.Line: Something that sizzled and popped...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! You had curry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ding ding ding♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She was right...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, we also had those things!
Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, what were they called?!
They're fluffy and gooey and stretch like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Fluffy, gooey and stretchy...?

rows.Line:
What about mochi? They're gooey...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

Can you give us more hints, Emu?!

rows.Line:
More hints...?

rows.Line:
So, umm...
You eat it by tearing it and dipping it in the curry!

rows.Line: You tear it and dip it...?

rows.Line:
Yeah, that's it!
How did you know, Saki?!

rows.Line: Because she said it was gooey and stretchy! That screamed cheese to me♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see...
I never would've thought of that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But not many people make naan at home! I really wanna try what you had now!

rows.Line: Then, you guys should come over to my house sometime for a naan party! We can have lots and lots of it together♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes, really!

rows.Line: Woohoo! Then, we should call it the great “We're In The Same Class! Let's Celebrate!” naan bake off!

rows.Speaker: Shiho

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll make lots and lots of naan for you, Shiho☆ We're gonna have cheese naan, chocolate naan, naan with whipped cream and...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

Wow...!

rows.Line: I'm not so sure about that...

rows.Line: I'm not sure growing in height has much to do with becoming more ladylike...

rows.Line: I don't think Saki's listening right now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, you're next!
Get ready to go down!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, Ichika is technically next in terms of height...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But shouldn't you be striving to surpass Honami instead?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But... Hona's way taller and way more ladylike than me... I don't think I'm ready to take on that sort of challenge yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

You're 161 cm tall, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:

rows.Line: I also grew a little, so I'm 162 cm now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wait, what...?

rows.Line: Looks like you couldn't close that gap.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*

rows.Line: Chin up, Saki. Don't worry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Line: I know you're sad about not outpacing her, but don't forget that you grew a whole centimeter this past year.

rows.Line: So, I think you should be focusing more on celebrating your growth.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: L-Luka...!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Yes, it's good to set goals for yourself like the one you just mentioned. However, if you're happy with your current results, I also think you should celebrate.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Based on what I'm seeing, it's more important to be a source of comfort and support.

rows.Line: Then, I'm gonna try to become a tall lady with a heart of gold!

rows.Line: And I'm gonna surpass you three someday!

se_run_women_001_1

rows.Line:

rows.Line: We're not supposed to meet with Mr. Shindo for a little while, but... I guess we should start making our way over so we don't end up running late.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm saying that we should strive to become the talk of the town!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In any case, I'm really excited.

rows.Line: Oh, you guys also need to come up with autographs for yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh, I think you're getting ahead of yourself. We sorta have more important things to figure out first...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you have time to think about that kind of stuff, then you should be practicing instead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Urgh... Y-Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, you used to take calligraphy lessons. I have a feeling your autograph is going to look really cool...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I can show you some tricks to make your autographs look super cool! I've already done a ton of research♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, practice takes priority.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, just gimme a second to explain!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All you have to do is make some sort of reference to your names. For example, Ichi, yours could include some stars, and yours could include a moon, Hona.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If you make them really small and add them as an accent, then they'll look really cute!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, your advice is more specific than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, does this mean you'd already come up with autographs for us...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, they came to me while I was thinking up my own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, we can refer to those when that time comes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. But to be fair, that's probably not going to be for a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait until then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, we need to start heading over to the office.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
Time really does fly when you're having a fun conversation.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...
But I'm starting to feel nervous all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the discussion we're about to have is about our future as a band! We need to make it a good one...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, everyone, let's go...!
Off to Solis Records!
