rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew...
That's it for my post-bath solo practice session!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My head felt refreshed after a bath, so my fingers really got moving!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: At the same time, I'll get all sweaty again if I start playing with everything I've got...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, what Shiho said today was so cool...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But what I saw that band do...
I thought it was the coolest thing in the world the way they pursued what they really loved.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And if somebody going through the same thing I did back then hears me play...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe they'll realize that it's okay to be yourself and do what your heart says. I wanna put on those kinds of performances for them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's what I want my music to be about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so glad she found an answer to that question she's happy with.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I mean, that story!
I had no idea about any of that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I knew she loved that band since she's recommended their stuff in the past... But she could've told us this story sooner!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Still, what she said today.
It all made so much sense.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Pursuing what you really love. Yeah, that is pretty cool... And Shiho is clearly doing that.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And Ichi also got to say what she wants to accomplish with our music...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (She wants to bring people together through music the way Miku does...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I really like that. It's so Ichi.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hona still seemed unsure, but I know she'll find the answer she's looking for...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I mean, she's the toughest one out of all of us! And we'll be there to help her if she thinks she needs it!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As for me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I tried writing a song that showed real empathy for someone who needed it. I wanted the listener to feel better after hearing it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to create more music like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so strange...
I remember being in so much pain back then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I was all alone for so long. I spent every day wishing that I'd get better and be back with the others as soon as humanly possible.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I was able to write a great song because of what I experienced. It's why I was able to get through to everyone else who was feeling lonely.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Because of the pain and loneliness I felt back then.
I was able to turn that into music...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I never thought what I experienced all those years ago would come back around to help me someday...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, that means... What I'm thinking and feeling now might help me in the future!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (All the stuff I've been thinking about and worrying over... I might be able to turn that into music for people to listen to someday...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright...!
That means I need to make the absolute most of each day moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna do my best with both our band and school! So that I can keep making amazing music!

rows.Line: Wow! So this is Puroland...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It looks so cute with all the ribbons and flowers everywhere.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Hehe, I'm so glad I finally got to come here!

rows.Line: We should make sure to thank Tsukasa again for the tickets.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Wow. I hope we get to see that too.

rows.Line: Yeah! They say when people ring the bell together, their bond becomes everlasting!

rows.Line: I didn't know they had something like that. That's kind of romantic.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, isn't it?!

rows.Line: Okay, then let's ring it. Which way do we go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's right above the Wisdom Tree where my brother's doing his show! C'mon, let's go!

rows.Line:
No way...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: With this many people ahead of us, we'll be waiting forever...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come on, Saki, let's line up too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Line:
But her room's still a mess...
Actually, I think it's messier than before.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My word...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?! Oh, Tsukasa, it's you...
How long have you been there?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Only a moment.
Sorry for interrupting you. I know you were focusing on your work.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, what happened to cleaning your room...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? No, my room...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I totally forgot!
I was so set on cleaning it too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'll just have to help you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, you will?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. Things will go much faster if we're both here to clean it, no? Just give me the word!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Tsukasa!
You're a lifesaver.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Always!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, let's get started...!
We're gonna make my room spotless...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And Ichi and I are gonna write the best song ever!!!
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hi, Saki. What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Today, I'm here to repay you for what you did!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Repay me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Remember how you made it possible for us to finish our song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really don't think it would've turned out so well if you hadn't done what you did, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'm going to do everything I can today to return the favor...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... I really appreciate it, but aren't you sort of blowing things out of proportion?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm not! Please, Ichi, let me do this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, if you're willing to go that far, then please go right on ahead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, what do you plan on doing exactly?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's a surprise!
For now, let's go!
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, here we are!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, I know this cafe...
Everyone in class has been talking about how good their churros are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, your class too? Everyone in my class has also been talking about how amazing they are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They've been saying how you can top freshly fried churros with chocolate and custard cream and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. The menu even says, “Enjoy crispy churros with a variety of scrumptious sauces! We recommend our special churros!” These look really good...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! I'm paying today, so get whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What? No, I can't make you pay.
I mean, I've been wanting to come here for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, but...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, how about you just buy me a drink...? This fruit juice looks pretty decadent compared to the others.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'll buy you a drink...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Anyway, let's go order.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! I didn't realize how crispy freshly fried churros are!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's so good...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, be careful not to burn your tongue...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry.
The sauce is doing a good job of cooling it down!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This chocolate sauce is amazing♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here, Ichi, try a bite! Open wide!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Wait, we're in public...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Then, at least try some of this chocolate sauce.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
In that case, you should try some of my caramel sauce...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm... I can't decide what to get next.
Oh, Ichi, check it out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They've got sauces made from apples, blueberries and a mix of fruits. They all sound really good...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wanna order a few things off this part of the menu...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, but are you really still that hungry?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whew... I'm getting pretty full...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait a second.
I'm having all the fun here. We're here because I'm supposed to be repaying you for what you did...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-Ichi, you gotta have some more!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you really don't have to wait on me hand and foot. I'd rather you just enjoyed yourself...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You looked so happy while eating those churros, Saki. That really put a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I think you've already given me back plenty.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, to make you smile even more, I'm gonna keep enjoying these churros!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, you gotta try this mixed-fruits sauce! It's really good!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks for offering.
Then, if you don't mind...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What am I doing...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (How could I forget to bring my assignment home yesterday? It's due today, but I didn't get to work on it at all...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's my birthday, so I was hoping to spend it in a good mood... But now things aren't looking so great...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But hey, I can't let myself get down like this!
I'm gonna get to school early and finish up that assignment!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Morning, Sakki♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin!
Wh-What's up? It's pretty early.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehehe. Oh, just a thing! Do you have a second to talk?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's no problem...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Great! She says she can talk, guys!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Guys”?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <One, two, three! Happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: <Happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, thanks guys!
What a surprise...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Sorry about that. We just wanted to celebrate your birthday.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So, we decided to all give our greetings together.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We thought we could surprise you that way, and it's nice to see it come true.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course it did! How could I not be surprised?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Well, we have Rin to thank...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <This was my idea, after all☆>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Right. Rin said we should wish you a happy birthday first thing in the morning, and... Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Uh, why are you outside?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Now that I think about it, it does feel early for you to be heading to school.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ohh, haha... So, I left this assignment there. I got up early today so I could go do it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was just feeling down about doing this on my birthday... But everything's looking up thanks to you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's great to hear! Birthdays are supposed to be happy!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I hope you'll get even more out of today since you got up so early.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too, thanks!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, it's so quiet...
Makes sense, since not many girls are here this early.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Looks like some are here for clubs...
Huh? Are people talking in the classroom...?
Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, finished. How does this look?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Happy Birthday Saki”... I think that's good!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki's sure to see it the moment she walks in since it takes up so much of the blackboard!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Great.
But the blackboard could still use a little something, I think.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case... How about drawing some balloons around it, like this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that could be good. We have a few different colors of chalk, so the board should pop much more if we use all of those.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, how about this? We could draw all kinds of stuff. Some gift boxes... And party poppers, and candles too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. I'm sure Saki will be happier if it really pops, so let's each add some drawings.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, look, you two.
Saki's desk is coming along nicely as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It really is. It's like you built a little castle...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is our Happy-Happy-Delicious Snack Castle, made entirely out of things Saki will love!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd be shocked if I showed up one morning and saw this on my desk.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, that's kinda the point of a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was a whole thing trying to find that flavor of potato chips Saki said she didn't get to try yet.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hehe. We had to split up and search all the supermarkets and convenience stores around here.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I'm glad we managed to get all the flavors they have out now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But with this many...will Saki be able to carry them all home?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't worry. I brought a large paper bag that she can use.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's Honami for you. We can always...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Did you guys hear something?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hwah? Is somebody here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's still pretty early...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why's she here already...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh-Uhh, Saki? You see, this is um...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Waaah! Thanks, you guuuys!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I never guessed you'd all surprise me like this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The snacks on my desk totally look like a castle! And they're all the kind I love!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your message on the blackboard is amazing too! This has to be what youth is all about!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That didn't go as planned, but I guess we can call it a success?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She does seem even happier than we thought she'd be.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's say it properly.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Thanks so much, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It makes me so, so happy to know you did all this for me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you think we can keep the blackboard like this for today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I doubt it, on account of the lessons.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It feels like a waste, but we need to clean this all up before morning homeroom, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, I've gotta get some pictures!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, not yet. We're not done with the blackboard...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, I'll help!
I want you guys to draw the presents, so... I'll draw the candles♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That doesn't seem quite right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Isn't it fine if it's what Saki wants?
Let's finish it up and get a picture with everyone.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This ended up being such a happy day...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You did receive plenty of warm wishes today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even right after what happened this morning, more of our classmates showed up and wished you a happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And it looked like some of your soft tennis clubmates came by during one of our breaks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm super duper extra grateful for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, did you get your assignment sorted okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehehe. I managed!
I did almost forget after all the excitement with the surprise, though.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That wouldn't have been good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I still can't believe you showed up that early.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Haha. Sorry, guys.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But hey, even though you guys might feel like your surprise didn't go right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For me, it was really nice getting to see you all preparing it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll take that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hey, want to stop by a diner before we go home?
It's been a while since we were all free after school, so it'd be nice to talk some more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, good idea. I second that plan.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine by me. Does that sound good to you, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
Hehehe, I can't wait♪
Diner

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Are there seats...? Yeah, it looks pretty open!
Excuse me, we're a party of four...
Oh, you guys! This way, over here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Huh?!
MORE MORE JUMP!?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! What a huge coincidence, running into you guys here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It sure is.
Speaking of coincidences, we happen to have eight seats here. Please, join us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Join you...? What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I think this surprise was a perfect success.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't think this is really a coincidence, do you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, we actually reached out to Minori and Haruka back when we were planning this morning's surprise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! We knew about that surprise plan, but we couldn't join in because of work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, we mentioned that not only would the two of us have time after school, but Airi and Shizuku would be able to make it as well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's how we decided to have another birthday surprise after school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Seriously? You guys are here just for me???

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's your birthday, do you need to ask?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haruka, Minori, Shizuku...!
Thank you so much for being here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so nice to see you this pleased.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, take a seat and let's order something. You're all hungry, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I saw this place has a “Birthday Plate”!
Wanna get this, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, thanks! I guess I will, since I'm here today!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew, that was a real shock...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't believe you guys had a Surprise Plan B!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not like we thought that all out ahead, though. It just kind of turned out that way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I've gotta say thank you to that coincidence then! It gave me such a fun time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Alright, I guess we should all be heading home.
See you tomor—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, wait, hold on!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What's wrong? Did you leave something behind?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, nothing like that... It's just, can we do one more thing first?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna go take Print Stickers together to commemorate today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Print Stickers?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! This morning, I was feeling all negative about how I forgot my assignment, but before I knew it, this became such a happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I wanna have something to remember it by!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
I think I know how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. It's your special day, so let's do it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahh, thanks Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't say I wouldn't go, did I?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Today's your birthday... Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahhh! Thank you, Shihooo! I love you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: H-Hey, now. That wasn't an invitation for a hug.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line:
Hahaha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Saki!
It was a lot of fun surprising you today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Your day got off to a wonderhoy start!
Getting to see you all smiles made me super smiley too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. And I was also happy to hear you wish we never had to clean the blackboard or take down the snack castle.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I had no idea what you were saying when you asked me how to build a castle out of snacks, Emu... But I'm glad she liked it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, happy birthday from me too, Tenma.
Let's celebrate the next time we get together. Just, try not to expect a surprise or anything...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Saki.
Azusawa showed me the photo you all took after that surprise. You had a vibrant smile, surrounded by your close friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I was reminded what wonderful friends you have! Do continue to treasure them as you live out your glorious school days!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Saki♪
That surprise birthday celebration must've been fun! Too bad I couldn't join in since we go to different schools.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it's not too late. If you leave it to me, I'm sure I can devise something that will leave Saki speechless.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm, that sounds super fun and all... But let's not, since Tsukasa looks pretty worried.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Tenma.
I heard about how Hinomori and Momoi celebrated with you at that diner. It's nice to hear that you had such a fun time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and our surprise went perfectly! I mean, Saki, your reaction would've been right at home on a variety show!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm tempted to celebrate her birthday every day if it means seeing her that excited every time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The rest of our celebration was fun, too. I definitely wanted to do something for your birthday, so I'm glad we got to spend that time together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah! We should do that again!
And I got lots of pictures of us together, so I'll send those over later, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were celebrating your birthday, but we ended up getting presents too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, the Print Stickers the four of us took.
We made another fun memory thanks to you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Those aren't my kind of thing... But I guess it can't hurt once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Again, Saki, happy birthday! Let's keep trying our hardest together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everybody! Thanks so much for the birthday wishes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My heart just feels so full knowing how much love I've gotten!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's enough to make me sure that I'll remember this day when I'm feeling down, and it'll perk me right back up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll keep doing my best to earn your support, so look forward to seeing what I do, okay♪
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I brought you some tea, Tsukasa!
It's really hot, so be careful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, much appreciated!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Nothing beats a cup of tea after a nice meal.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It is pretty relaxing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you're going to be filming the music video for your debut song soon. Do you feel ready...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ready? I mean, I know more or less how it's gonna be shot and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! I was gonna ask you a question about it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Apparently, we won't just be playing our song. They're gonna film us doing a bunch of other stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like sitting on stairs or walking down underground passageways and stuff. The usual things you see in these kinds of music videos.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but we won't be going outside. It's all gonna be shot at a special studio...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, interesting!
And I'm sure it'll turn out great!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... But I'm worried about how I'm gonna look, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really hope I don't freeze up or something while we're shooting...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? But you've always liked having your picture taken, no...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: People such as yourself always seem to be more in their element when they see a camera pointed at them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, when I'm hanging out with people and stuff! But we're talking about our professional debut here. A real music video...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm gonna be sooo nervous!
I'm willing to bet the ice cream I always have for dessert on that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your confidence in that matter isn't particularly encouraging...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, have you been told what sorts of expressions you should be making throughout...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Umm...
The director who's on site that day is supposed to tell us what to do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But our manager said that we shouldn't be asked to do anything that difficult since it'll be based on our song's overall feel and lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, your task is simple!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, really?! Go on!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All you have to do...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is focus on your own feelings!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uhh... What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The facial expressions you make need to be reflective of your song's theme and lyrics, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, I believe you should try to focus on the lyrics being covered during each cut and what you want to convey.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stay true to your feelings, know how you want people to view your song and do what you can to help yourself succeed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

rows.Line: Yeah, the corner shop that acted as a sort of landmark has changed, but the instrument shop should still be there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Since it's right there, wanna go check it out?

rows.Line: Here. This one, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's still here!
Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, we haven't been here in a really long time...

rows.Line: No, we haven't. We've mostly been getting everything we need at the shop by the live house.

rows.Line: That reminds me of...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The conversation we had while looking at the guitar on display in the window!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: The guitar they have on display is so cool! And the bass next to it's super shiny!

rows.Line: Of course it's shiny. It's brand new.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Wow...
I hope I get to play a cool guitar like this someday.

rows.Line:
O-O-O-One hundred thousand yen?!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Probably years. That's including New Year's money.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: B-But! You can buy it if you save lots and lots, right?!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: My dad even said how finding a guitar you really want can motivate you to save and practice.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Oh, and he's a pro! That means it's gotta be true!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: On the other hand, you can't buy skill with money. You gotta be good if you're gonna play a high-end model.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Without the proper skills, you won't be able to make the most of your instrument.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...
If I'm going to own a guitar like that, then I'll want to play it well.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Then, how much better do you think we'd have to become before we can start using instruments like these?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: What do you think, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm... A hundred times better?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: A-A hundred times...?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: What?! That can't be right, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, it's the truth.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I remember that conversation. We were so adorable back then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Actually, compared to back then, how much better do you think we've gotten?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Good question!
What do you think, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've made our debut as pros, so it's gotta be like a thousand times or something, right?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, personal space.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Maybe not a thousand...
But I'd say at least five hundred.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Then, doesn't that mean it's okay for us to play high-end instruments like the ones they had on display back then?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, we could even start talking about boutique brands.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But everyone has their preferences.
Going for the most expensive thing isn't necessarily the right choice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, this makes me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too! I mean, we've improved five hundredfold!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, while we're here, why don't we ask to see if we can try playing some of their instruments?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Who knows? We might even find the next model we want♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: True. They might have a nice keyboard or drum kit in stock.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's go!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's do our best again during practice today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You've been so full of energy since this morning, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's because Jam Fest is just around the corner! We gotta practice harder than usual in order to get ready for it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it is important for us to stay focused.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, it's happening soon...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It always felt so far off...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, Ichi, I totally get what you mean!
I was also surprised when I realized that it was just a few days away!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I felt the same thing as well.
But doesn't that go to show how much we've been able to focus on practicing?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We only have one song left in the set list to work on, so I think we've been having productive practices.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, let's keep doing our best to really master it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It's full steam ahead until the festival...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've been practicing so much that I think we've forgotten about something really important...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, what are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is what I mean! We haven't packed yet, right?!

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, do we need to bring anything special with us...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nothing out of the ordinary, I think?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've gotten everything together that we usually need for our shows, so I don't think we need anything special...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we do! Lots of things!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is our first big festival!
So, we gotta have all our ducks in a row!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, so what else do we need?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uhh... Oh!
An outdoor venue usually means lots of bugs!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, we gotta take bug repellent and stuff! What if a big swarm comes and causes us to lose focus while we're playing?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If it's an area where bugs like to gather, then I'm sure that the venue staff will have countermeasures in place.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo didn't mention anything regarding that, did he?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm talking about just in case!
Because some of us like to have backup plans in place!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What else is there...? I know!
We might wanna take some medicine with us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why medicine?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if we get so nervous that we drink too much water and get stomach aches?! Who knows if there's going to be a hospital nearby?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm not sure we'd be able to play anyway, if it's bad enough we would have to go to the hospital...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess it's true nerves can cause stomach pain, but—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna put on the best show we can, so we should have all our bases covered!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Should we bring neck pillows with us so we can sleep during the trip over? What about blankets in case it's chilly in the green room!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How much luggage do you plan to bring?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're not going on vacation or anything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I do sort of understand how you feel, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We have to prepare for every show we do, but this is an especially big event. As such, it's natural for us to feel nervous.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And that nervousness is going to be our Achilles' heel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. If possible, I'd like for us to play like we normally do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, we should do what we can to ensure that we do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Agreed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, we may want to take that other thing with us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! What other thing?! Tell me!

rows.Line: Alright!!

rows.Line: I took care of everything on my to-do list just for this day! I even finished all my homework early! Sometimes I impress even myself!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:

I couldn't be in better condition for this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know we're just watching my music video on the TV together, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense! We're talking about a music video starring my dear little sister! There is no way that I'm going to miss it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're that excited about seeing it?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'm glad I asked you to join me♪ Let's get to it, then!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'll play it now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, it takes place at a school!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! The theme revolves around youth, which suits us perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I see. This does seem like the best way to visually represent your song!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki, there you are!
Hmm... Interesting...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, why'd you pause it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, pardon me! I couldn't help but notice your superb acting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The way you looked around, smiled and laughed felt incredibly natural!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
That was actually kinda hard.
You should've seen how robotic I was at first.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But then they filmed me chatting with Ichi and the others, who were off camera, and it turned out really well♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. A trick specific to music videos with no lines, I imagine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, I apologize for pausing it.
Let's continue!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika seems different compared to normal. She has an air of calmness and maturity to her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She was asked to act all cool and grown-up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
She was really worried she wouldn't get it right.
But she did such a good job!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm impressed! Her portrayal of this character is simply marvelous!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, why'd you pause it again?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The way you walked into the classroom and started talking to Ichika...! That was magnificent, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite not having any lines, the expression on your face makes it so clear that you're doing your best to cheer up your friend!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks.
But the best part's actually about to come up...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, my apologies!
In that case, let's endeavor to watch it all the way through without any further pauses!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, what happened to no more pauses?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm incredibly sorry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you need to let me talk about this current scene, Saki! I know I said I'd stop pausing, but I'll have to rewind this part!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Argh! Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that was an excellent music video!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As it should be, considering you're the sister of a future star! Without question, you stole the show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thanks♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That makes me really happy! I asked you for a lot of help when we did our other one, so I tried really hard on my own for this one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Figuring how which expressions to make and how to move was really hard, but it was also an interesting process.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, it's wonderful to hear that you enjoyed acting to this extent...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. To be fair, all I did was dip my toes in.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I'm glad to hear that you enjoyed this experience! I couldn't be happier as a stage actor!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes. Yes, I'm happy...
That feeling is genuine, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I admire the way you took on this challenge all by yourself, but... I wouldn't have minded helping you a little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When it comes to acting, at least, I can perhaps still be of some assistance to you, you know? Yes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sure that we're gonna shoot more videos in the future, so I'll be sure to ask you if I ever get stuck!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, please do!
I promise to answer any questions that you bring to me! Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa.
Tenma Household  - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She's been like this since the walk home yesterday.
Why'd you have us gather at SpoJoy Park?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because we've been practicing nonstop lately, y'know? It's important for us to take our minds off of things by getting in a little exercise!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it is important for us to give our minds a rest when we can, but you're just here to play, aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Since Saki went out of her way to invite us, let's also try to have as much fun as we can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, why don't we start by doing some warm-up stretches?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, we're gonna have so much fun today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You hit the first pitch...!
That's really impressive.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm taking the box!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't look away, Shiho!
You gotta watch me knock it out of the park!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I just need to press this button, and... Oh, it's starting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Watch closely and get your timing right.
The ball will fly out when the pitcher on the screen throws.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Watch closely... Watch closely... Wait, now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You swung after the ball passed you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I did?! Then, I've gotta start swinging a lot faster... Now!
Wh-Why can't I hit it?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's four hits in a row. You're starting to get a good arc on it, so how would you feel about going for a home run next...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't know... That still sounds really hard, but I could give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Now I see...
I think I have a better idea of what I need to do after watching Hona.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll get it right this time...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, nice one.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Ichika
rows.Line:
Nooow!
Now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The goal of this game is to make as many shots as you can in one minute... But the interesting part is how it's brought their personalities to the surface.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika's trying to be as precise as possible with each shot, while Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Go! Go! Go!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
She's trying to take as many shots as possible.
So, who's gonna win?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, how many points do you have?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ten. How about you, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Eight! I'm losing, but it's not over yet!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, Saki just scored two more points back to back!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that's time...
I would've won, if only that last shot made it in...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, I hit the net!
I'm so sorry, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's okay. It's still our match point, so let's try to stay calm and close things out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's keep our comeback alive, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, ready...? Service!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's good, but it's still returnable...!
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nice smash, Hona!
I'll finish things off like... This!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow...! Nice volley!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Hona, high five!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was so much fun! This day just flew by.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also got really excited.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our free-throw battle did end up being really close! I'm definitely gonna win the next time we visit!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're already talking about next time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Still, Saki, you have so much stamina now.
You don't seem tired at all after doing all those activities.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh. Feel free to start calling me Leo/need's Queen of Stamina.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Q-Queen of Stamina...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Doesn't that title belong to Honami?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, you're right...!
Then, I'll be the first queen in line to the throne!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't think you're considered a queen if you're still in line for the throne...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
But being second only to you is still a really amazing thing♪ So, I'm fine just being first in line!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhumhumm♪ Humhmhumm♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I ended up buying so much stuff.
I can't wait to see what Ichi and the others bring!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're here much earlier than usual, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hi, Luka!
The thing is, I need to get some stuff set up!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Set up...? Oh, the bag you're holding is full of snacks and juice. Are you having a party?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! After practice, we're gonna throw a “Let's Keep Doing Our Best Together” party!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That sounds like fun.
Also, the title for your party... Did you come up with it, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, that's right... How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Because it had you written all over it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hold on a second. Are you throwing this party because of what happened the other day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know we told you guys all about it the other day, but it was such a strange dream. I honestly wished that some of the things that happened were real...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But even though the us in that dream were all friends, we weren't really close.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The me in that dream thought it was a sad situation, but she didn't do anything to fix it. That was really frustrating...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I was also able to make some really important realizations!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How we get to work as a band every single day, go to school and study together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can't take any of those things for granted.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So... How do I put it?
I want to cherish the time we get to spend together even more!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I suggested we throw a “Let's Keep Doing Our Best Together” party!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's so wonderful.
I'm sure Ichika and the others feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I'm guessing they're out buying their favorite snacks right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is that so? I'm looking forward to seeing what they all bring.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right on cue.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right on cue...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you planning something weird again?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Who's to say?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: More importantly, did you all remember to bring snacks today?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I bought some cookies and madeleines at the shop I mentioned the other day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Their baked goods are really delicious and have the perfect texture.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, they smell delicious!
They probably are amazing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I decided to buy some drinks since I knew that you'd all be getting snacks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I knew you'd be getting drinks too, Saki...
But I figured it wouldn't be easy to bring enough for everyone on your own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks so much, Ichi!
Now we can have as much as we like to drink during our party!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika's drinks balance things out between us. I sorta just bought these without much thought.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, an assorted set of snacks!
Did you get this for me, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, they're for everyone.
Lemme guess, Saki. You bought a bunch of potato chips like usual.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's right♪
I can't wait to have them with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand why you're excited, but they'll have to wait until we've finished practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You, Miku and the others are also invited, Luka. We'll need to tell them later.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, we can join?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! We want to take this opportunity to say, “We look forward to working with you guys moving forward!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But first, practice.
I'll go get Miku and them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, we should get everything set up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. I can't wait to have that party with everyone! Also...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How we get to work as a band every single day, go to school and study together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can't take any of those things for granted.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi! Hona! Shiho!
Let's have another great practice today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!
